free_tier_limits: Public API listings are delayed by 24 hours. Remotive advises no more than 4 requests per day and blocks clients exceeding 2 requests per minute.
rate_limits: Maximum 4 requests per day is advised; more than 2 requests per minute will be blocked.
description: Remotive provides a public unauthenticated JSON GET API for active remote job listings, with category, company_name, search, and limit filters. Results are delayed by 24 hours. Reuse requires Remotive attribution and backlinks, and submitting listings to third-party job sites is prohibited.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: corrected; the public API has a 24-hour delay and documented request constraints (https://remotive.com/remote-jobs/api, https://github.com/remotive-com/remote-jobs-api#request-rate-limiting). rate_limits: corrected to the official 4/day guidance and >2/minute blocking rule (https://github.com/remotive-com/remote-jobs-api#request-rate-limiting). description: corrected to disclose delayed data, supported filters, attribution/backlink requirements, and the third-party job-site restriction (https://remotive.com/api-documentation).
